title: DatasetQuery
description: The re-runnable selection CRITERIA that produced a Dataset, stored separately from the snapshot so the same criteria can be applied to the growing corpus later to pull more data. Referenced by Dataset.queryRef.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this record's own shape

recordedAt.description: When this record was written, as distinct from when the thing it describes happened

supersedes.description: w3ds:// reference to the record this one replaces

deleted.description: Soft-delete marker; the envelope itself stays, because W3DS has no delete

name.description: Query name as the person typed it

scope.description: Which corpus the criteria run over.

access.description: Access filter within one's own vaults.

imgMode.description: Restrict to images that already carry annotations, that carry none, or to all

crops.description: Crop names to restrict the selection to; empty means no crop filter

weeds.description: Weed species to restrict the selection to

soil.description: Soil types to restrict the selection to

robot.description: Identifiers of the machines whose captures to keep

region.description: Regions to restrict the selection to

dateFrom.description: Earliest capture date to include, inclusive

dateTo.description: Latest capture date to include, inclusive

createdBy.description: eName of the person who saved the query
